items.title: Don Wolff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: So when I get calls for Lawrence Welk, he doesn’t make my show.

ctx.x: Yeah. I’m real thrilled with the show I’m doing right now which is a four hour jazz show on KMOX which is a 50,000 clear channel watt station, it reaches some 48 states. I get phone calls from all over the country and Canada every Saturday night. It’s a very powerful midwestern station which also is the sports voice of St. Louis so we have the Cardinals which reach a great many homes, and I come on after the ball game. We have

the blues and so it’s a sports station and it’s a talk radio station, and one of the few AM stations that’s really survived in a marketplace that they’ve become relics. But this particular station is quite successful and they allow me to bring in my own music, I’ve never been told that I can’t play this or I can’t play that, so I have total freedom and independence in what I do and so I design my programs as if I’m the listener. And I figure that if I’m going to enjoy the music, chances are my listeners will too.…
I guess you can only go by your own tastes and your own likes, you know you can’t second guess your audience.
